title_en: Famous Restaurants (18/20): A Buddhist Temple Vegetarian Restaurant
note_en: 不管 A 还是 B，都 C means "no matter whether A or B, C is true either way": 不管是信佛的人还是普通游客，都可以来这里吃一顿素斋 "whether you're a Buddhist or an ordinary tourist, you can come here for a vegetarian meal." English needs only "whether... or," but Chinese also requires 都 ("in all cases") in the second clause; leaving it out sounds incomplete.
